headline: BEAKER introduces an expert-curated benchmark for embodied multimodal models in chemical laboratories
summary: A 2026-11-04 arXiv paper introduces BEAKER, an offline benchmark of 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types for multimodal models considered as embodied systems in self-driving chemical laboratories. The authors report evaluation of 28 models and find persistent weaknesses in fine-grained action grounding, laboratory apparatus and state recognition, safety norms, and ordering steps in mid-length procedures. These results are author-reported; the benchmark does not test closed-loop device interaction.
